user.title: Powerpal Connection Mode
user.description: Choose how to connect to your Powerpal device.

ble_device.title: Select Powerpal Device
ble_device.description: Select your Powerpal device or enter its MAC address manually.

pairing.title: Powerpal BLE Configuration
pairing.description: Enter the pairing details for your Powerpal device at {address}.

data_description.bluez_bonding: Bonds the device at the Bluetooth level for link-layer encryption. Required for most setups.
data_description.api_key: Your Powerpal API key (UUID format). Enables cloud uploads and historical data. Leave empty for BLE-only mode.
data_description.device_id: Your Powerpal device ID. Required for API features. Found on the ESPHome logs or the Powerpal app.

connection_mode.title: Powerpal Connection Mode
connection_mode.description: A Powerpal device was discovered at {address}. Choose how you want to connect to it.

data_description.connection_mode: Direct BLE connects from HA's Bluetooth adapter. ESPHome uses an ESP32 running ESPHome as BLE proxy.

esphome.title: ESPHome Power Entity Configuration
esphome.description: Enter the entity ID of the ESPHome sensor that provides power readings (in watts) from your Powerpal device. The ESPHome device handles the BLE connection and computes power on-device; this integration uses the power value directly for energy tracking.

data_description.esphome_power_entity: The entity ID of the ESPHome sensor publishing power in watts (e.g. sensor.powerpal_power).
data_description.api_key: Your Powerpal API key (UUID format). Enables historical data backfill when HA was offline. Leave empty to skip.
data_description.device_id: Your Powerpal device ID. Required for API features. Found in the Powerpal app or ESPHome logs.

error.entity_not_found: Entity not found. Check the entity ID is correct and the ESPHome device is online.
error.invalid_api_key: Invalid API key format. Must be a UUID (e.g. abcdef01-2345-6789-abcd-ef0123456789).
error.invalid_device_id: Device ID cannot be blank whitespace.

abort.already_configured: This Powerpal device is already configured.
